tagline: Citi, the global bank for the world's most dynamic economies.
hero_kpi_rationale: Primary revenue driver at Citi, heavily influenced by interest rates and loan portfolio management. Source of significant growth in a high-interest-rate environment.

kpis.name: Net Interest Income
kpis.explanation: Difference between interest income earned and interest paid.
kpis.description: Net Interest Income increased by $5.7 billion in 2025, driven by higher interest rates and improved margin management.
kpis.signal: Strong growth driven by rising rates.

kpis.name: Total Interest Income
kpis.explanation: Sum of all income generated from loans and investments.
kpis.description: Supported by corporate and consumer lending, this income reflects the size and profitability of the asset portfolio.

kpis.name: Total Interest Expense
kpis.explanation: Total amount paid on deposits and borrowings.
kpis.description: Interest expenses increased due to higher rates on deposits and long-term debt.

kpis.name: Trading VaR
kpis.explanation: Measure of daily loss risk at 99% confidence over a one-day holding period.
kpis.description: Average VaR decreased by $6 million, indicating a reduction in risky positions and improved trading portfolio management.

kpis.name: Total Employees
kpis.description: Citi continues its operational streamlining with a 2% reduction in headcount in 2025.

kpis.name: Trading VaR
kpis.explanation: Measure of daily loss risk at 99% confidence over a one-day holding period.
kpis.description: Average VaR decreased by $6 million, indicating a reduction in risky positions and improved trading portfolio management.

kpis.name: Net Interest Income
kpis.explanation: Difference between interest income earned and interest paid.
kpis.description: Net Interest Income increased by $5.7 billion in 2025, driven by higher interest rates and improved margin management.
kpis.signal: Strong growth driven by rising rates.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale. Indicateur clé pour les investisseurs orientés revenus.
kpis.description: 5-year history of declared dividends per share (2021-2025).

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel du cash redistribué aux actionnaires : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions (treasury stock).
kpis.description: For 2025: cumulative dividends + share buybacks in billions USD.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du bénéfice net redistribuée en dividendes. Au-dessus de 80 % indique un dividende potentiellement non-soutenable.
kpis.description: Dividends / net income for 2025 (based on net income attributable to shareholders).

ai_positioning.summary: The company does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing.
